current_answer: Choose by the job and the evidence path. Use PaulRBerg Frontend Design when an existing or substantial screen already has a system and you need one project-bound direction held to local constraints, then rendered inspection at the states and widths that matter. Its source is mutable, declares a chromium-browser dependency, and the pool did not run it. Use OpenAI Product Design Ideate when you need three image-based directions for a new or redesigned screen before build work; use Frontend App Builder when you need its concept-to-browser workflow. The other lanes remain separate: Anthropic Frontend Design for text-led visual direction; PracticalSwan Frontend Design 2.0 for substantial work with an explicit state model; Wenkang Frontend Design for human visual decisions on a real route; Vercel skills for React composition, transitions, UI review, and performance; Agent Browser and Dogfood for capture and exploratory QA; Frontend Testing & Debugging for a named rendered change; and Product Design Audit for a captured flow. Eleven of fourteen listings are source-pinned. Frontend Testing & Debugging, Product Design Ideate, and PaulRBerg Frontend Design are current mutable sources. None has been independently installed, executed, or compared on a shared frontend task by this pool.
